```{r setup, include=FALSE}
    knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)    
    require(tidyverse)
    require(ggridges)
    require(haven)
    require(corclass)
    require(qgraph)
    require(EGAnet)
    require(Hmisc)
    require(patchwork)
```

```{r data wrangling and imputation}
      set.seed(1234)
      num <- function(x) {
       as.numeric(x)
        }
      taste.dat <-  read_dta("C:/Users/Omar Lizardo/Google Drive/MISC DATA SOURCES/SSI-2012/SSI2012.dta") %>% 
      select(ends_with("taste"), -c("altertaste", "rtaste")) %>% 
      type.convert(as.is = TRUE)  %>% 
      mutate(across(ends_with("taste"), recode,  `1` = "3", `2` = "1", `3` = "2", `4` = "NA")) %>% 
      mutate(across(ends_with("taste"), as.integer))
      imp.res <- aregImpute(~ classicaltaste + operataste + jazztaste + bwaysttaste + moodeztaste + bbandtaste +
                                 croldtaste + countrytaste + bluegtaste + folktaste + hymgostaste + latspsaltaste +
                                 raphiphoptaste + blurbtaste + reggaetaste + toppoptaste + controcktaste + 
                                 indalttaste + danclubtaste + hvymtltaste, 
                                 data = taste.dat, n.impute = 1, nk = 0)
      taste.dat.i <- as.tibble(impute.transcan(imp.res, data=taste.dat, imputation = 1, list.out = TRUE, pr = FALSE, check = FALSE))
      attr(taste.dat.i, "imputed") <- NULL
      taste.dat.i <- taste.dat.i %>% 
        rowwise() %>%
        mutate(taste.sd = sd(c_across(classicaltaste:hvymtltaste))) %>% 
        filter(taste.sd != 0) %>% 
        select(-taste.sd)
      taste.dat.nm <- taste.dat %>% 
        na.omit() %>% 
        rowwise() %>%
        mutate(taste.sd = sd(c_across(classicaltaste:hvymtltaste))) %>% 
        filter(taste.sd != 0) %>% 
        select(-taste.sd)
```
```{r factor analysis plot, fig,width = 10}
    f1 <- c(12, 13, 14, 15, 19)
    f2 <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 11)
    f3 <- c(7, 16, 17, 18, 20)
    f4 <- c(8, 9, 10)
    gen.groups <- list(f1, f2, f3, f4)
    efa.res <- factanal(taste.dat.i,factors = 4, rotation="promax")
    windows(width = 10, height = 6, rescale = "fit")
    fa <- qgraph(efa.res$loadings, 
           node.width = c(rep(1, 20), rep(1.5, 4)),
           label.scale = FALSE, label.cex = 0.8,
           groups = gen.groups, borders = FALSE, 
           edge.labels = TRUE, minimum = 0.1, 
           edge.label.cex = 0.8, edge.width = 0.8, theme = "colorblind",
           labels = c("Classical", "Opera", "Jazz", "Broadway", "Easy", "Big Band", "Classic.Rock", "Country", "Blueg.", "Folk", "Gospel", "Latin", "Rap", "Blues", "Reggae", "Pop", "Cont.Rock", "Alt.Rock", "Dance", "Metal"))
    savePlot("C:/Users/Omar Lizardo/Google Drive/WORK/IN PROGRESS/CULTURE/lizardo-taste-schemas/png/efa.png", type = "png")    
```

```{r schematic class analysis with imputed values}
      cca.res <- cca(taste.dat.i, filter.value = 0.01)
      taste.dat.c <- bind_cols(cca.res$membership, taste.dat.i) 
      names(taste.dat.c) <- c("Class", "Classical", "Opera", "Jazz", "Broadway", "Easy", "Big Band", "Classic.Rock", "Country", "Blueg.", "Folk", "Gospel", "Latin", "Rap", "Blues", "Reggae", "Pop", "Contemp.Rock", "Alt.Rock", "Dance", "Metal")
```

```{r making class-specific data tables}
    dat1 <- filter(taste.dat.c, Class == 1)
    dat1 <- select(dat1, -"Class")
    dat2 <- filter(taste.dat.c, Class == 2)
    dat2 <- select(dat2, -"Class")
    dat3 <- filter(taste.dat.c, Class == 3)
    dat3 <- select(dat3, -"Class")
    dat4 <- filter(taste.dat.c, Class == 4)
    dat4 <- select(dat4, -"Class")
    dat5 <- filter(taste.dat.c, Class == 5)
    dat5 <- select(dat5, -"Class")
```

```{r data for centrality plots, message=FALSE}
    c1 <- centralityTable(qgraph(cor_auto(dat1), DoNotPlot = TRUE, sampleSize = nrow(dat1)))
    c2 <- centralityTable(qgraph(cor_auto(dat2), DoNotPlot = TRUE, sampleSize = nrow(dat2)))
    c3 <- centralityTable(qgraph(cor_auto(dat3), DoNotPlot = TRUE, sampleSize = nrow(dat3)))
    c4 <- centralityTable(qgraph(cor_auto(dat4), DoNotPlot = TRUE, sampleSize = nrow(dat4)))
    c5 <- centralityTable(qgraph(cor_auto(dat5), DoNotPlot = TRUE, sampleSize = nrow(dat5)))

    lab.names <- c("Classical", "Opera", "Jazz", "Broadway", "Easy", "Big Band", "Classic.Rock", "Country", "Blueg.", "Folk", "Gospel", "Latin", "Rap", "Blues", "Reggae", "Pop", "Contemp.Rock", "Alt.Rock", "Dance", "Metal")
    mes.names <- c(rep("2. Betweenness", 20), rep("3. Closeness", 20), rep("1. Strength", 20), rep("4. Exp. Inf.", 20))
    c1$node <- lab.names
    c2$node <- lab.names
    c3$node <- lab.names
    c4$node <- lab.names
    c5$node <- lab.names
    c1$measure <- mes.names
    c2$measure <- mes.names
    c3$measure <- mes.names
    c4$measure <- mes.names
    c5$measure <- mes.names
    c1 <- c1 %>% 
      select(3:5) %>% 
      filter(measure != "4. Exp. Inf.")
    c2 <- c2 %>% 
      select(3:5) %>% 
      filter(measure != "4. Exp. Inf.")
    c3 <- c3 %>% 
      select(3:5) %>% 
      filter(measure != "4. Exp. Inf.")
    c4 <- c4 %>% 
      select(3:5) %>% 
      filter(measure != "4. Exp. Inf.")
    c5 <- c5 %>% 
      select(3:5) %>% 
      filter(measure != "4. Exp. Inf.")
```

```{r centrality plots}
    p <- ggplot(data = c1, mapping = 
                  aes(x = reorder(node, value), y = value, color = measure, group = 1))
    p <- p + geom_line() + geom_point() + coord_flip()
    p <- p + facet_grid( ~ measure) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Schema 1")
    p1 <- p + theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
    
    p <- ggplot(data = c2, mapping = 
                  aes(x = reorder(node, value), y = value, color = measure, group = 1))
    p <- p + geom_line() + geom_point() + coord_flip()
    p <- p + facet_grid( ~ measure) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Schema 2")
    p2 <- p + theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
    
    p <- ggplot(data = c3, mapping = 
                  aes(x = reorder(node, value), y = value, color = measure, group = 1))
    p <- p + geom_line() + geom_point() + coord_flip()
    p <- p + facet_grid( ~ measure) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Schema 3")
    p3 <- p + theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
    
    p <- ggplot(data = c4, mapping = 
                  aes(x = reorder(node, value), y = value, color = measure, group = 1))
    p <- p + geom_line() + geom_point() + coord_flip()
    p <- p + facet_grid( ~ measure) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Schema 4")
    p4 <- p + theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
    
    p <- ggplot(data = c5, mapping = 
                  aes(x = reorder(node, value), y = value, color = measure, group = 1))
    p <- p + geom_line() + geom_point() + coord_flip()
    p <- p + facet_grid( ~ measure) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Schema 5")
    p5 <- p + theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
    wrap_plots(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, nrow = 2)
    ggsave("C:/Users/Omar Lizardo/Google Drive/WORK/IN PROGRESS/CULTURE/lizardo-taste-schemas/png/cent.png", width = 12, height = 7)
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
    taste.dat.l$genre <- rep(lab.names, nrow(taste.dat.i))
    ridg.all <- ggplot(taste.dat.l, aes(x = eval, y = reorder(genre, eval))) + geom_density_ridges2() + scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c('Dislike','Mixed','Like')) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Full Sample")
    ridg.1 <- ggplot(taste.dat.l1, aes(x = eval, y = reorder(genre, eval))) + geom_density_ridges2() + scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c('Dislike','Mixed','Like')) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Schema 1")
    ridg.2 <- ggplot(taste.dat.l2, aes(x = eval, y = reorder(genre, eval))) + geom_density_ridges2() + scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c('Dislike','Mixed','Like')) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Schema 2")
    ridg.3 <- ggplot(taste.dat.l3, aes(x = eval, y = reorder(genre, eval))) + geom_density_ridges2() + scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c('Dislike','Mixed','Like')) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Schema 3")
    ridg.4 <- ggplot(taste.dat.l4, aes(x = eval, y = reorder(genre, eval))) + geom_density_ridges2() + scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c('Dislike','Mixed','Like')) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Schema 4")
    ridg.5 <- ggplot(taste.dat.l5, aes(x = eval, y = reorder(genre, eval))) + geom_density_ridges2() + scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c('Dislike','Mixed','Like')) + labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Schema 5")
  ridg <- wrap_plots(ridg.1, ridg.2, ridg.3, ridg.4, ridg.5, nrow = 1) & theme_minimal()
  ridg
  ggsave("C:/Users/Omar Lizardo/Google Drive/WORK/IN PROGRESS/CULTURE/lizardo-taste-schemas/png/ridge.png", width = 16, height = 4)
```
